text:
alex_infra: Heads-up — vendor just messaged they can hold 4x H100 standby in apac-east for a 6hr window tonight starting 22:00 UTC if we confirm by 19:00. Need someone to sanity-check quota and give thumbs for the canary run. @lia_vendor can you confirm the hold details?

lia_vendor: Yep, we can lock the racks for you for 6hrs. Need PO ack or signed invoice link. Holding without invoice for 2 hours then release. ETA for paperwork from finance is ~90m. :clock1:

joy_engineering: Re: quota — checked project redwood-canary-prod, current GPU_QUOTA_H100 = 0. We can request a temporary increase but cloud ticket takes ~1–2h usually. Filed ticket #CLOUD-8123 with priority = high. Link: https://console.cloud/tickets/CLOUD-8123 :spiral_calendar:

alex_infra: Ugh. If ticket takes too long we can fallback to 2x A100 for the canary (lower perf). But need to update the TF pool config before the run. @sam_ops can you prep a quick patch?

sam_ops: Will open a tiny PR to add a fallback pool config and roll logic. Drafting now. PR: https://git/repo/pulls/789 — includes a runtime flag and rollout schedule. PTAL @joy_engineering when you're free. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

joy_engineering: Looking at PR. Quick note — keep the KV cache flush timeout at 500ms for H100 path, and 700ms for A100 fallback. Otherwise tail latency spikes. Also add a canary label so console shows this run separately.

alex_infra: Good call. Here's the tf snippet I'm planning to apply (small):
```hcl
resource "redwood_gpu_pool" "canary_pool" {
  name        = "canary-night-2026-03-18"
  region      = "apac-east1"
  instance_type = var.use_h100 ? "h100-large" : "a100-large"
  capacity    = var.use_h100 ? 4 : 2
  labels      = { canary = "true", owner = "eng-infra" }
}
```

lia_vendor: Confirmed hold fields: vendor_hold_id=VH-5543, racks=2, gpus_per_rack=2, hold_expires=2026-03-18T21:00:00Z (that's 19:00 UTC deadline). Invoice URL sent to finance. If invoice clears before deadline we keep the hold.

joy_engineering: Finance replied — they're routing to Payments, expect OK around 18:30 UTC. If we get the OK, ticket CLOUD-8123 becomes a formality. If not, we'll run with A100 fallback.

sam_ops: PR updated per comments: added canary label + kv flush time switch. Triggering CI now. CI badge: green in ~7m. If green I can merge and queue the plan+apply to staging.

deploy-bot: CI passed for PR #789 — unit tests (12), infra-lint (5) — plan shows changes to 1 resource. Plan summary: +1 redwood_gpu_pool.canary_pool (capacity: 4 or 2 depending on var).

alex_infra: OK — if Payments clears we'll go H100. If not, A100 fallback. I'll wait for finance update and then send final go/no-go at 19:05 UTC. Thanks for the quick turnaround all. :thumbsup:

joy_engineering: :eyes: will stand by for the final. If we do A100, I'll tweak canary traffic to 10% to reduce cost.

lia_vendor: Noted. I can extend hold by 1hr if you confirm partial PO (we need at least email ack).

sam_ops: Merged and queued apply to staging (eta ~12m). If you want me to hold the prod apply until you say go, I will.

alex_infra: Hold prod apply until my go message at ~19:05 UTC. Thanks.

joy_engineering: copy that.

lia_vendor: ping me here if you need me to escalate invoice.

alex_infra: Final: Payments approved at 18:27 UTC, vendor hold confirmed. Proceeding with H100 canary. Merging prod apply now. Thanks everyone. :tada:
